title: Sega Superstars Tennis (Sega Superstars Tennis ReMatch)
description: A native Windows/Linux port of the Xbox 360 version of Sega Superstars Tennis, recompiled with the ReXGlue SDK (v0.10.0). The game's code runs as native x64. Its graphics run on a native Direct3D 12 renderer that translates the game's Xbox 360 shaders, not an emulated GPU.
